findings.tp_fp_justification: RcuReadGuardInner stores `ptr_ref: Option<P::Ref<'a>>` constructed eagerly; lrh2000: 'This still needs to be *mut Target. The conversion to Ref<'_> needs to happen later to avoid the soundness issue (as we cannot really have Ref<'a>)'. Storing the reference-like value for 'a is unsound for the RCU guard API.

findings.message: This claim isn't true if we support `Weak<T>`. Please check all the comments and update accordingly.
findings.tp_fp_justification: The into_raw safety contract added to the unsafe trait NonNullPtr claims the raw pointer 'must be valid to be immutably accessed or borrowed until from_raw is called'; lrh2000: 'This claim isn't true if we support Weak<T>' (the target can be dropped while the Weak lives). Incorrect safety contract of an unsafe trait that Rcu relies on for soundness, not mere prose.
